Parent issue: #454

Stage: entrypoint-prefilter

## Task

Implement only Task 1a from parent #454 as the first PR in the stack. In agent-entrypoint.yml, guard the mention-trigger branch with sender.type != 'Bot' and replace the broad contains(toJSON(github.event), handle) check with event-specific checks limited to the active trigger title/body/comment/review text. Preserve supported event coverage and the separate unmentioned follow-up branch. Add focused workflow-envelope tests proving bot-authored events and handles appearing only elsewhere in the payload allocate no runner, while valid live mentions still enter the router. Document the existing bot-to-bot limitation and describe skipped workflow runs accurately; leave edited-event idempotency to #437. Do not implement early reactions, concurrency changes, answer-first routing, approval-offer, metadata removal, or Task 3 in this child.

## Base

- base_branch: main
